title: Noetherian finite selection of stalk tests
statement:
Let $X$ be Noetherian, let $F$ be a constructible abelian etale sheaf, and let
$(\phi_\lambda:F\to G_\lambda)_{\lambda\in L}$ be a family of maps to
arbitrary abelian etale sheaves. Assume that for every geometric point $\bar
x$ and every $0\neq v\in F_{\bar x}$, some $\lambda$ satisfies
$(\phi_\lambda)_{\bar x}(v)\neq0$. Then a finite subset $L_0\subset L$ makes

$$
 (\phi_\lambda)_{\lambda\in L_0}:
 F\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{\lambda\in L_0}G_\lambda
$$

a monomorphism. In particular, the conclusion holds if at each geometric point
some single $\phi_\lambda$ is injective.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-irreducible-lisse-strata] to obtain a finite partition $X=\coprod_i S_i$ into nonempty irreducible locally closed subschemes on which $F|_{S_i}$ is locally constant with finite geometric stalks. Choose a geometric generic point $\bar\eta_i$ of each stratum.

For each $i$, the finite group $F_{\bar\eta_i}$ has finitely many nonzero elements. For every such element $0\ne v$, the hypothesis supplies an index $\lambda$ with $(\phi_\lambda)_{\bar\eta_i}(v)\ne0$; choose one such index for each $v$ and call the resulting finite set $L_i$. The map $F|_{S_i}\to\bigoplus_{\lambda\in L_i}G_\lambda|_{S_i}$ is injective at $\bar\eta_i$.

source.place: Lemma 09Z6 (lemma-constructible-maps-into-constant), proof of (1), parenthetical partition alternative; same argument for (2)

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-generic-kernel], this finite-sum map is a monomorphism on every $S_i$. Let $L_0=\bigcup_iL_i$; it is finite. At a geometric point lying on $S_i$, projection from the $L_0$-sum to the $L_i$-sum shows that the stalk map $F_{\bar x}\to(\bigoplus_{\lambda\in L_0}G_\lambda)_{\bar x}$ is injective.

source.place: Lemma 09Z6 (lemma-constructible-maps-into-constant), proof of (1), parenthetical partition alternative; same argument for (2)

proof.text: Let $K$ be the kernel of the resulting map. Exactness of geometric stalks [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact] identifies $K_{\bar x}$ with the kernel of the stalk map, hence every $K_{\bar x}$ is zero. Thus the map $K\to0$ is an isomorphism at every geometric stalk, and [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] makes it an isomorphism; therefore $K=0$ and the finite-sum map is a monomorphism. The construction uses no finiteness or constructibility assumption on the $G_\lambda$.
